# How It Works

`features/how-it-works` &middot; section-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

A process section: a heading and three to four steps side by side with circled numbers and a closing button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | features |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | `"How it works"` |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Circled steps on the page background color.
- **light**: On the surface color. Sets `background: @colors.surface`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Number markers are table cells, circles render as squares. | Steps stack on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/how-it-works', {
  "steps": [
    {
      "title": "Tell us your size",
      "description": "Two minutes, no measuring tape."
    },
    {
      "title": "Try it at home",
      "description": "Wear it for up to 60 days."
    },
    {
      "title": "Keep what you love",
      "description": "Send back the rest for free."
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "Find my size",
    "href": "https://example.com/pages/size-guide"
  }
}) ]]
```
